title: When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents
abstract: arXiv:2611.32446v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Human annotations on documents (such as arrows, carets, strikethroughs, and insertions) express corrective intent yet existing OCR and document understanding systems treat these marks as visual noise rather than semantic edit operations. We introduce intent-aware OCR, the task of generating corrected transcriptions by jointly reasoning over original document content and visual intent cues (handwritten or digital) that convey edit intent. To support this setting, we present DocIntent, a multimodal dataset of 1,600 financial documents with over 5,700 annotated visual intent cues, each paired with layout-aware, intent-resolved OCR targets. We further introduce IntentBench, a 216-document benchmark designed to evaluate model robustness under diverse real-world annotation conditions. translated_title: 当墨水遇上像素：面向人工修正金融文档的基于视觉语言模型的意图感知OCR
translated_abstract: 文档上的人工标注（如箭头、插入符号、删除线和插入内容）表达了修正意图，然而现有的OCR和文档理解系统将这些标记视为视觉噪声而非语义编辑操作。我们提出了意图感知OCR（intent-aware OCR）这一新任务，即通过联合推理原始文档内容和传达编辑意图的视觉意图线索（手写或数字形式）来生成修正后的转录文本。为支持这一任务设定，我们提出了DocIntent，一个包含1,600份金融文档的多模态数据集，其中包含超过5,700个标注的视觉意图线索，每个线索均与布局感知、意图解析后的OCR目标相配对。我们进一步引入了IntentBench，一个包含216份文档的基准测试集，旨在评估模型在多样化真实世界标注条件下的鲁棒性。利用DocIntent，我们在直接意图监督下针对修正后的转录文本微调了DocIntentOCR，这是一套包含30亿和70亿参数规模的视觉语言模型。
tldr: 该论文提出“意图感知OCR”新任务，构建了包含1,600份金融文档、5,700余个视觉意图标注的DocIntent数据集及IntentBench评测基准，并训练出DocIntentOCR视觉语言模型，使OCR系统能够理解文档上的人工修正标记（如箭头、删除线等）并生成修正后的转录文本。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the task of intent-aware OCR, presents the DocIntent dataset (1,600 financial documents with over 5,700 visual intent annotations) and the IntentBench benchmark, and trains DocIntentOCR vision-language models that enable OCR systems to interpret human correction marks and generate corrected transcriptions.
